characters.summary: Tim Drake is a master detective, highly trained martial artist, and tactical genius who utilizes advanced gadgets, staff combat, and stealth to overcome physically superior opponents.
weaknesses: Human physical limitations
Vulnerable to heavy ballistic or superhuman blunt force trauma
limitations: Lacks superhuman strength, speed, or durability
Relies heavily on gear and preparation

sources.supports: General background, equipment, and role as Tim Drake's superhero identity.

feats.claim: Successfully deduced Batman's secret identity independently through detective work.
feats.citation: Batman: A Lonely Place of Dying

notableResults.note: Defeated Ra's through strategy and tactical maneuvering.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes Batarangs, smoke pellets, and specialized combat tech from his belt.
Employs stealth tactics and misdirection in combat environments.

unknowns: Exact capabilities fluctuate between Post-Crisis and New 52 iterations.

characters.summary: Red Tornado is an android endowed with the power to generate and manipulate devastating winds and tornadoes, granting him potent flight and ranged area-of-effect offense.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magnetic manipulation
Susceptible to high-level tech hacking or disabling frequencies
limitations: Core consciousness can be separated from the android shell
Power output depends on mechanical integrity

sources.supports: History, android nature, and aerokinetic powers of Red Tornado.

feats.claim: Created massive hurricane-force winds capable of dispersing large groups of superhumans.

notableResults.note: Often compromised or disassembled when corrupted by external forces.

unknowns: True extent of his elemental mastery compared to pure air elemental entities.

characters.summary: Eobard Thawne harnesses the Negative Speed Force to manipulate time, travel at extreme hyper-accelerated speeds, phase through solid matter, and generate destructive electrical attacks.
weaknesses: Arrogance and psychological obsession with Barry Allen
Vulnerability to disruptions in the Speed Force
limitations: Can cause temporal paradoxes that threaten his own existence if mismanaged
Requires connection to the Negative Speed Force

sources.supports: Abilities, Negative Speed Force connection, and history of Eobard Thawne.

feats.claim: Traveled through time across multiple centuries under his own power.

notableResults.note: Their eternal conflict results in frequent stalemate or temporal resets.

campaignTags.claim: Generates and projects Negative Speed Force lightning.
Possesses an accelerated cellular regeneration rate.

unknowns: Exact limits of his paradoxical immortality after various continuity reboots.

characters.summary: Edward Nygma is a criminal mastermind who relies on complex traps, elaborate riddles, puzzle-themed gadgetry, and psychological manipulation rather than direct physical combat.
weaknesses: Compulsive need to leave riddles and clues
Poor physical combat skills in direct confrontation
limitations: Physically ordinary human with no superhuman attributes
Ego often leads to preventable mistakes

sources.supports: Character traits, intellectual profile, and use of traps and puzzles.

feats.claim: Deduced Batman's secret identity independently using pure intellect.

notableResults.note: Always apprehended once Batman solves his core riddles.

campaignTags.claim: Employs custom puzzle-themed explosives and weaponized canes.

unknowns: Extent of his temporary reform periods.

characters.summary: Damian Wayne is an elite child prodigy trained by the League of Assassins from birth, combining lethal swordsmanship, acrobatics, and tactical ruthlessness with advanced Bat-family tech.
weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence in his combat training
Impulsive temperament under emotional provocation
limitations: Human physical body subject to standard injury and fatigue
Prone to rash decisions due to youth and pride

sources.supports: Background as son of Batman and Talia al Ghul, League of Assassins training.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple adult League of Assassins operatives in single combat.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill during leadership disputes.

campaignTags.claim: Carries standard Robin utility belt gear and batarang variants.
Utilizes League of Assassins stealth and infiltration techniques.

unknowns: Fluctuations in his adherence to Batman's non-lethal code.

characters.summary: Saint Walker is the first Blue Lantern, channeling the blue light of hope to inspire allies, heal wounds, negate fear constructs, and empower nearby Green Lantern rings.
weaknesses: Power severely diminishes when separated from a Green Lantern or targets devoid of hope
Relies entirely on emotional spectrum energy
limitations: Blue rings cannot manifest lethal offensive constructs without a Green ring present to supercharge them
Requires active hope to function at peak capacity

sources.supports: Saint Walker's role as the first Blue Lantern and his ring-based powers.

feats.claim: Pacified raging combatants across a battlefield using waves of calming hope energy.

notableResults.note: Assisted in turning the tide against the undead horde using hope light.

campaignTags.claim: Heals injuries and revitalizes beings using the Blue Light of Hope.
Flies through space via Blue Lantern ring propulsion.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of hope ring constructive power without green energy amplification.

characters.summary: Jonathan Crane is a former professor of psychology who uses specialized fear toxin and psychological terror to incapacitate victims by forcing them to experience their worst hallucinations.

mechanisms: Gas mask protection against his own toxin
Subterfuge and hiding behind hired thugs

weaknesses: Physically fragile and poor in direct physical brawls
Obsession with fear makes him predictable
limitations: Human physical conditioning with no superhuman durability
Relies on chemical preparation time for his toxins

sources.supports: Scarecrow's background, fear toxin usage, and psychological motif.

feats.claim: Successfully drove entire city blocks insane using modified aerosolized fear toxin.

notableResults.note: Defeated once Batman builds immunity or filters out the fear toxin.

campaignTags.claim: Uses chemical delivery systems, gas grenades, and fear toxin dispensers.

unknowns: Variations in formula potency across different story arcs.

characters.summary: Billy Batson transforms by uttering the magic word 'Shazam', gaining the wisdom of Solomon, strength of Hercules, stamina of Atlas, power of Zeus, courage of Achilles, and speed of Mercury.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magic-based attacks
Can be reverted to a child if tricked into saying his name again
limitations: Base mortal form is an ordinary human child (Billy Batson)
Transformation requires uninterrupted speech of the magic word

sources.supports: Origins, powers derived from mythological figures, and transformation mechanics.

feats.claim: Stood toe-to-toe with Superman in physical exchanges, trading blows that shatter surroundings.

notableResults.note: Their magical battles frequently level entire city blocks without a definitive victor.

campaignTags.claim: Powers originate from ancient divine magic and the wizard Shazam.
Summons and projects magical lightning from the heavens.
Flies at hyper-speed through divine magic.

unknowns: Exact scaling of wisdom and power adjustments between older continuity and New 52.

characters.continuity: DC Comics (Infectious / Dark Nights: Death Metal era)
characters.summary: King Shazam is a corrupted version of Shazam infected by the Batman Who Laughs, wielding amplified dark magic alongside his standard divine attributes with ruthless malice.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to purity or light-based cleansing forces
Infection-driven madness can lead to tactical errors
characters.formDifferences: Corrupted by the Batman Who Laughs infection, replacing his standard moral restraint with sadistic cruelty and dark magical empowerment.

sources.supports: Context on Shazam variants and infection plotlines in DC events.

unknowns: Full duration and permanency of the infection without universe-cleansing events.

characters.summary: Thaal Sinestro is the master of fear, wielding a Yellow Power Ring to forge terrifying energy constructs, instill absolute terror in opponents, and project lethal yellow beams.
weaknesses: Ring requires periodic recharging via fear battery
Overreliance on psychological intimidation
limitations: Power ring charge depletes with heavy usage
Vulnerable if opponents overcome their fear entirely

sources.supports: History as Green Lantern, founder of Sinestro Corps, and yellow light mastery.

feats.claim: Single-handedly subjugated entire planetary populations using fear propagation.

notableResults.note: Their ring-slinging duels span galaxies with fluctuating outcomes.

campaignTags.claim: Flies through space and atmosphere using his Yellow Power Ring.
Instills paralyzing fear and psychological dread into victims.

unknowns: Exact power amplification when bonded with entity Parallax.
